item.title: Candle Ad Without Photos

turns.text: I don't have a photo. Make a 15-second 9:16 ad for a candle: clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label. Warm evening light, gentle camera moves and soft piano, no voice. Show “A little evening calm”, then finish with “Find your glow”.

item.tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: Clear straight-sided glass jar with ivory wax, one wick and no label; no photo is available.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm evening light, calm mood and gentle camera movement. Setting and shot choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: “A little evening calm”, followed by “Find your glow” at the end.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft piano, no voice; English text.

must_haves: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
“A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
Soft piano is audible with no speech.

I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I used only the free planning tools.

### Recommended budget version: 257 credits
Still **15 seconds, vertical 9:16, at 480p**, using free-plan LTX 2.5:

| Part | Duration | Credits |
|---|---:|---:|
| Opening card: “A little evening calm” | 2 seconds | 0 |
| Candle shot with gentle camera movement | 10 seconds | 240 |
| Closing card: “Find your glow” | 3 seconds | 0 |
| Soft piano, no voice | 17-second track, trimmed to fit | 17 |
| **Total** | **15-second finished ad** | **257** |

The candle shot would follow your jar, wax, wick, no-label and warm-light specifications. Separate text cards keep the wording exact rather than risking AI-generated misspellings.

### Cheaper alternatives
- **Less motion, same 15-second runtime:** shorten the generated candle shot and hold the text cards longer. Each second removed from generated footage saves **24 credits**.
- **Shorter ad:** also reduces the video cost; I can get a precise revised quote before generating.
- **Smaller:** 480p is the lowest supported resolution for this workflow, so there’s no smaller-resolution saving available here.
- **Silent:** saves 17 credits, but drops your requested piano.

I can’t verify your remaining balance with the available tools. Also, Magic Hour’s guide says **commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or agreed paid usage arrangement**—free-plan generation alone doesn’t establish commercial-use rights.

Would you like the **257-credit version**, or a cheaper plan with less moving footage?
